mechanism: Fish oil (omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids) may potentiate anticoagulant/antiplatelet effects and theoretically increase bleeding risk; sodium valproate may affect platelet function and rarely causes thrombocytopenia, creating additive risk.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; counsel patient on bleeding precautions; consider baseline and periodic platelet counts if concurrent use is necessary; separate dosing timing if possible.
